mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, 0, #{message}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(status = 2, 0, status), message = #{message}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT fr.id AS id, fr.from_user_id AS fromUserId, fr.message AS message, fr.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl FROM friend_request fr JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fr.from_user_id WHERE fr.to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND fr.status = 0 ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC, fr.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_request WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 0
